about_the_game:
Terradune is a hand-drawn, top-down 2D action RPG focused on real-time combat, exploration, and buildcraft. You travel through harsh regions, dive into dungeons, and gradually shape a playstyle that feels like yours using skills, upgrades, and ability-changing augments.

If you enjoy action RPGs where fights reward positioning and timing, and where your build meaningfully changes how you approach encounters, Terradune is built for you.

WHAT YOU DO IN TERRADUNE

  • Explore distinct regions like deserts, forests, and ancient ruins, and search off the main path for secrets and hidden routes

  • Accept quests, meet characters, and uncover what happened to Terradune’s world

  • Enter dungeons to face tougher enemies, traps, and boss encounters that guard valuable rewards

  • Collect loot and upgrades to grow stronger and unlock new options

  • Customize your abilities using augments that change gameplay, not just numbers

REAL-TIME COMBAT THAT REWARDS DECISIONS

Combat is fast and hands-on. Enemies have patterns you can learn, and your success comes from choosing when to commit, when to reposition, and when to punish openings.

  • Read enemy tells and respond with the right timing

  • Use positioning to avoid getting surrounded and control space

  • Mix ranged pressure, close-range risk, and magic utility based on your build

  • Win fights through smart choices, not grinding

BUILD YOUR CHARACTER WITH SKILLS, UPGRADES, AND AUGMENTS

As you progress, you unlock and upgrade abilities, then shape them further with augments. Augments are designed to change how an ability behaves so different builds feel meaningfully different.

Examples of what augments can do:

  • Change an attack’s role, such as turning it into crowd control, single-target burst, or a safer option

  • Add utility, such as slowing enemies, applying a debuff, or giving a defensive payoff for good timing

  • Create synergies, so your abilities work together instead of feeling isolated

  • Support different playstyles, from aggressive and fast to careful and methodical

The goal is simple: your build should affect your moment-to-moment decisions, not just your damage numbers.

EXPLORATION, DUNGEONS, AND REWARDS

Terradune rewards curiosity. Optional paths and hidden areas can lead to loot, upgrades, unique encounters, and dungeon entrances. Dungeons push the difficulty up and pay it back with stronger rewards and important build options.

  • Hidden routes, secrets, and optional challenges off the main path

  • Dungeons that test your build and your decision-making

  • Boss fights that guard powerful rewards

QUESTS AND A WORLD WITH HISTORY

Meet characters, take on quests, and piece together the history of Terradune. The story provides direction and mystery, while combat and exploration are the core of the experience.

PLAYTEST AVAILABLE

A Steam playtest is available and players are automatically accepted. If you want to help shape Terradune, jump in and share feedback. Wishlisting also helps a lot and keeps you updated as development continues.
